column1: # RECLASSIFIED BY H15: these are CREATION-TIME 0x45684 resolves (family-2 variant0 nibble), NOT the post-transform DISPLAY palette. After a marker-chain transform 0x4092E clears +0x27 (bit6=0) and 0x45684 is not re-run, so the DISPLAYED palette is the compositor control-byte nibble -> see h15_materialized_render_palettes.tsv (authoritative for display).
